Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value From activities Inner Join assays On activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id Inner Join target_dictionary On assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid Inner Join molecule_dictionary On activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno Left Join compound_structures On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno Filter activities.standard_relation = '=' And activities.pchembl_value Is Not Null And target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1853' And target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' Sort molecule_chembl_id Ascending, assay_chembl_id Ascending Limit 1000
